# Crown Acquisition Group

> Financial Clarity for Growing Startups — Crown Acquisition Group helps early-stage startups optimize their financial operations with C-level support.

Crown Acquisition Group is led by Mohamed Hachicha, a CFO for venture-backed companies in LA and the Bay Area. They work with founders whose growth has outpaced their finance systems.

## Pages

- [Home](https://crownag.com/): Overview of Crown Acquisition Group's fractional CFO services for growing startups.
- [Clarity Check](https://crownag.com/landing/clarity-check): A free 10-question diagnostic of a startup's financial hygiene, runway visibility, reporting cadence, and operational gaps, followed by a free clarity session with Mohamed Hachicha.
